description: Complete trade setup in one call. Bundles signal bias, regime, levels, setup (entry, stop, target, R:R), odds of target-before-stop and of touching target within 7 days, time-to-target, invalidation, and track record. tf sets candle size and lookback (5m=1H to 1w=1Y); shorter is faster but noisier. Neutral bias returns odds of hitting resistance before support. For one piece only, call get_signal_bias ($0.01) or get_market_regime ($0.005) — cheaper. Costs $0.03 USDC per call (x402).
name: get_trade_plan
